fields_for_human_confirmation.canonical_role_expected: Prevent accidental duplicate command/replay processing for a real observed signal.
fields_for_human_confirmation.what_it_proves: The Composition Root Shadow command type requires an idempotencyKey string.
fields_for_human_confirmation.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove that a real production/official platform signal already emits idempotencyKey, nor that the field exists outside the shadow command contract.
fields_for_human_confirmation.risk_if_accepted_as_real: Could incorrectly clear ROB-004 and allow observer design based on a shadow command field rather than a real signal field.
fields_for_human_confirmation.risk_if_rejected: May delay observer design even though the shadow command already has a canonical target name for future mapping.
fields_for_human_confirmation.evidence_needed_to_clear: A non-fixture, non-shadow, non-UI real signal/type/service showing idempotencyKey, or explicit Miguel confirmation that this shadow command field is the canonical real-observation contract target.

fields_for_human_confirmation.canonical_role_expected: Correlate official signal, shadow command/result, and replay trace without mutating production.
fields_for_human_confirmation.what_it_proves: The Composition Root Shadow command type requires a correlationId string, and later trace types also carry correlationId.
fields_for_human_confirmation.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove that a real official flow/event emits correlationId or that requestId/traceId/runId are equivalent.
fields_for_human_confirmation.risk_if_accepted_as_real: Could conflate shadow trace correlation with a real official signal correlation contract.
fields_for_human_confirmation.risk_if_rejected: May leave ROB-004 open despite a clear canonical shadow-side trace field that can guide future schema.
fields_for_human_confirmation.evidence_needed_to_clear: A real signal/type/service contract carrying correlationId, or explicit Miguel confirmation of the accepted equivalent and boundary.

fields_for_human_confirmation.canonical_role_expected: Reference the official comparable result without executing or mutating the official flow.
fields_for_human_confirmation.what_it_proves: The Shadow E2E observed signal can carry an officialFlowRef for fixture/replay comparison.
fields_for_human_confirmation.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove that the real official flow emits a stable comparable officialFlowRef, nor that fixture officialFlowRef values are real.
fields_for_human_confirmation.risk_if_accepted_as_real: Could incorrectly clear ROB-005 and imply a real official-flow comparator exists when only the fixture/shadow E2E contract is shown.
fields_for_human_confirmation.risk_if_rejected: Observer design remains blocked until a real comparator reference is discovered or defined.
fields_for_human_confirmation.evidence_needed_to_clear: A real official-flow/result reference contract from non-fixture code, or Miguel confirmation that officialFlowRef is accepted only as a future canonical field, not current real evidence.

rob008.reason: Even if Miguel confirms idempotencyKey, correlationId and officialFlowRef as valid canonical names, synthetic fixture fields remain fixture-only and do not become real evidence.
evidence_required_to_close: Non-fixture real signal carrying idempotencyKey or approved equivalent.
Non-fixture real signal carrying correlationId or approved equivalent.
Non-fixture real official flow/result reference carrying officialFlowRef or approved equivalent.
No-cableado proof that those fields are read without UI, WorkMap, Significado, DB/Supabase write, runtime mutation, registry, export or diagnosis.
